import os
import sys
import traceback


def _report_uncaught_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback):
    details = "".join(
        traceback.format_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback)
    )
    # Register before third-party imports so their failures are captured too.
    try:
        error_path = os.path.join(
            os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "training_error.log"
        )
        with open(error_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(details)
    except OSError as logging_error:
        print(f"Could not save training traceback: {logging_error}",
              file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    print(details, file=sys.stdout, flush=True)
    sys.__excepthook__(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback)


sys.excepthook = _report_uncaught_exception
